name: zanker-design-critique
description: Critique rendered interface for coherence, hierarchy, suitability and visual polish.

workflow.instruction: Review screenshot at realistic viewport with product audience and task in mind.
Score hierarchy, typographic quality, spacing, affordances, identity, states and readability with evidence.
Differentiate normative violations from taste or aesthetic preference.
Recommend concrete improvements with screenshot positions and expected effect.

fallback: Give bounded heuristic critique when target cannot render.
